source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB Add SEL; Partial Add, Delete and Clear are separate operations.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A/0x44 with fixed-looking record and Sensor Type placeholder; check sel list; clear logs.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Does not validate record schema, sensor semantics, capacity or cleanup.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires one approved SDR-backed synthetic record, returned-ID readback and targeted retention/cleanup.
historical_reviews.history: Platform Event has different routing/PEF semantics.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Never use Clear SEL as cleanup.

original_test_intent: Add one valid synthetic SEL record, prove exact returned content and repository delta, and protect unrelated history.
original_method: Send Storage 0x0A/0x44 with a complete record payload and verify it through SEL readback.
manual_activity: Owner approves one synthetic record, repository capacity/PEF isolation and retention or targeted cleanup.
agent_execution_scope: Read returned ID and full record

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic sel add hides exact payload and does not meet returned-ID/raw-record coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected 0x0A/0x44 with one validated full record, then raw-read the returned ID and compare all fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source payload, placeholder, Script and timing preserved but not blindly executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline/export SEL, add one approved record, verify exact delta and retain or target-delete only that record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds semantic payload validation, capacity/PEF safety and targeted cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Rendered sel list or completion does not prove raw record integrity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Synthetic history may be mistaken for a real fault or consume scarce capacity.

project_override_considerations: A vendor add API is equivalent only with identical record fields, returned identity, capacity/side-effect and cleanup evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and command align; placeholder payload needs approval but is not a core contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operation is clear; valid record and cleanup are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents blind synthetic fault insertion and broad log deletion while proving exact record identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Add SEL writes persistent audit history, so the oracle is the exact returned record ID and byte-for-byte decoded record, not list appearance. Capacity and PEF/monitoring side effects must be checked before insertion, and cleanup—if allowed—must target only that identity.
